meta.note: License conclusions are transcribed from vendor official license pages and license texts; fields not stated on official pages read “Check the official page”. group values: photos, illustrations, icons, fonts, aggregators. status values: active (free long term, check the official page). cardRequired is always null; the field does not apply to asset downloads. overageBehavior is not applicable (no usage allowance). specText covers resource form and scale; figures not given on official pages read “not verified”. license object: licenseScope values single / per-family / per-set / per-resource; non-single entries show no unified license conclusion, only “Check per item”; attribution tiers are none / embedded-notice / notice-retained / credit-required / per-set / per-resource / unverified; fields without textual basis use unverified; evidence holds short verbatim English quotes from official pages; conflicts show differing statements inside official pages side by side. offers.title: Pexels (photos and videos)
offers.specText: Photos and videos; photo and video counts not verified
offers.durationText: Free long term (check the official page)
offers.limitsText: No standalone sale or distribution; no use as a trademark, trade name, or service mark; content depicting trademarks must not be used for commercial purposes for goods and services; depicted rights are not covered
risks: Standalone means no creative effort applied and essentially the same form as on the platform; adding only a filter, color change, resize, or crop still counts as standalone

Depicted rights (identifiable people, logos, brands, products, buildings, audio/video samples, organizations) are not covered; check whether third-party consent or a license is needed before commercial use — responsibility rests with the user
Section 1 of the terms reserves the right to modify the terms at any time, including the right to cancel or change the license granted
The help page and section 4 of the terms differ on CC0; follow the marking on the photo page
offers.notes: The terms are marked Last updated: October 20th, 2026. Other official pages: help page https://help.pexels.com/hc/en-us/articles/360042295174-What-is-the-license-of-the-photos-and-videos-on-Pexels ; license (use-case) page https://www.pexels.com/photo-license/ . Use cases named on the license page include websites, e-commerce, newsletters, ebooks, presentations, blogs, templates for sale, ads, banners, marketing campaigns, printed items (flyers, postcards, magazines, books, CD covers), and social media. The terms state no geographic restriction. The free scope and rate limits of the Pexels API are not verified — check the official page.

license.paywallBoundary: The terms and help page mention no paid tier or download limit — check the official page. The free scope and rate limits of the Pexels API are not verified — check the official page.

evidence.commercialUse: irrevocable, worldwide, perpetual (or as long as allowed by law), non-exclusive and royalty-free right to download, use, copy, modify or adapt the Content for commercial or non-commercial purposes
evidence.attribution: You do not need to credit Pexels or the contributor of Content when you use it, but it is certainly appreciated when you do so
evidence.modification: download, use, copy, modify or adapt the Content for commercial or non-commercial purposes

statements: Help page: All photos and videos uploaded on Pexels are licensed under the Pexels license.
Terms, section 4: some content is licensed under CC0; CC0 content is content marked “CCO” (spelling in the terms) on the photo page, usable for personal and commercial purposes without attribution.
conflicts.handling: Follow the marking on the photo page; both statements are shown side by side without a ruling.

offers.title: unDraw (illustrations)
offers.specText: Illustrations, assets, and vector graphics; illustration count not verified
offers.durationText: Free long term (check the official page)
offers.limitsText: No compiling assets to replicate a similar or competing service; no distribution as a package; expressly no use for AI training, fine-tuning, or development; brand logos in illustrations are provided only to present the brand itself
risks: The AI training ban covers generative AI training data, ML datasets, model fine-tuning, AI system training/validation/testing, and automated processing; such use needs separate express written permission from unDraw
The ban extends to linking, embedding, scraping, searching, or downloading site assets without consent, by automated or non-automated means
Trademark use is not addressed on the license page — check the official page
The existence and contents of unDraw Plus are not verified — check the official page
offers.notes: The license page is marked Copyright 2026 Katerina Limpitsouni. The full license page mentions no paid tier and states no geographic restriction. Brand logos in illustrations are registered trademarks of their respective owners, included for promotional purposes, with no association with unDraw or the user and no endorsement by trademark holders of unDraw or vice versa.

license.paywallBoundary: The full license page mentions no paid tier — check the official page; the license page gives no illustration count — not verified.

offers.title: Font Awesome Free (icons)
offers.specText: Icons (.svg and .js file types), web and desktop font files, code files; Free plan $0/year, 1 Project Kit, 10k pageviews a month; icon count not verified
offers.durationText: Free long term (check the official page)
offers.limitsText: No use of the Font Awesome name in a project name; brand icons only to refer to the company, product, or service represented; do not remove the attribution comments in downloaded files
risks: All three licenses require attribution; downloaded Free files already contain sufficient embedded attribution comments, so normal use needs nothing additional; the license page asks users not to remove comments, especially in code
Modification terms are not stated separately on the license page — check each license text
A general ban on reselling the icons themselves is not stated on the license page — check the official page
The Free plan excludes Pro icons, Pro+ icons, icon downloads, hosted npm, API access to Pro icons, perpetual licenses, and Figma
offers.sourceName: Font Awesome official free license page
offers.notes: The license page is marked Last updated: July 12, 2018. Pricing page https://fontawesome.com/plans.md : Free plan $0/year, 1 Project Kit, 10k pageviews a month, including WordPress and AI Agent Tools; the pricing FAQ states the free plan has no trial and no time limit and Free icons can be used indefinitely. Paid annual prices: Starter $48/year (Pro icons via CDN, 5 Kits, 50k pageviews); Solo $96/year (adds Pro+ icons, downloads, npm, Figma, perpetual license, 10 Kits, 1M pageviews); Team $192/year (3 seats minimum, 20 Kits, 2M pageviews). Pro+ icons are included only in Solo and Team. Whether visible on-screen attribution is required is not required by the license page — check the license page.

license.paywallBoundary: Free plan $0/year, 1 Project Kit, 10k pageviews a month; paid plans Starter $48/year, Solo $96/year, Team $192/year (annual prices); Pro+ icons only in Solo and Team. Free icon count not verified.

evidence.commercialUse: Font Awesome Free is free, open source, and GPL friendly. You can use it for commercial projects, open source projects, or really almost whatever you want.
evidence.attribution: you shouldn't need to do anything additional

offers.title: Google Fonts (font library)
offers.specText: Font library; the Noto collection covers 1,000+ languages and 150+ writing systems (Noto collection figures, not whole-library figures); total font count not verified
offers.durationText: Free long term (check the official page)
offers.limitsText: Licenses differ per font — check each font; Product Sans is not available; attribution requirements are not stated in the FAQ — check each license text
risks: OFL restrictions must not be written as whole-library restrictions; the FAQ states that licenses differ per font
Google Sans and Google Sans Flex were for Google use only before November 2025 and now use the SIL Open Font License
Use of a font in logo text does not equal trademark registration — check the official page
offers.notes: The FAQ page copy was captured on 2026-11-03; pages must state that date. The FAQ states that all fonts are open source and without cost, usable in commercial products and even included in commercial products for sale; the most common license is the SIL Open Font License, with some fonts under the Apache license or the Ubuntu Font License. Fonts can be used on print, websites, apps, teaching materials, ebooks, storefronts, jewelry, and any surface. Text in bitmap or vector graphics made with the fonts can be modified; the fonts themselves can also be modified with a font editor, subject to license conditions. With self-hosting, Google receives no visitor data (a dedicated FAQ section; technical note).

license.paywallBoundary: The FAQ mentions no paid tier — check the official page; total font count not verified.

evidence.logoTextUse: you can use Google Fonts within any logo
evidence.cost: No, all Google Fonts are open source and are without cost.

A note at the top of LICENSE.txt states that “Source” is a trademark of Adobe in the United States and/or other countries

The requirement to keep the font software under this license does not apply to any document created using the font or a derivative. LICENSE.txt mentions no paid tier and states no geographic restriction. The correspondence between Noto Sans/Serif CJK and Source Han fonts is not verified.

offers.title: Iconify (icon aggregator)
offers.specText: Aggregation catalog and distribution tool for icon sets; first 631 lines read, 4,882 lines total; set count and icon total not verified
offers.durationText: Free long term (check the official page)
offers.limitsText: No unified license — check the license and license URL of each set; the license of the Iconify software itself is not verified

Catalog markings do not replace upstream license texts; upstream LICENSE files for Tabler, Material Symbols, and others were not read in full

offers.notes: License examples from the portion read (evidence only that licenses differ; not license conclusions for each set): Material Symbols Apache 2.0, 15,810 icons, author Google; Material Design Icons Apache 2.0, 7,447 icons, author Pictogrammers; Material Design Light Open Font License, 284 icons; Tabler Icons MIT, 6,545 icons, version 3.51.0; Solar CC BY 4.0, 9,102 icons; Lucide ISC, 2,052 icons; IconaMoon / Basil / Pixel Icon CC BY 4.0; most other sets read are MIT or Apache 2.0. offers.title: Figma Community resources
offers.specText: Community design files, slide templates, plugins, and widgets
offers.durationText: Free long term (check the official page)
offers.limitsText: Creators can add or replace terms — check the license marking on each resource page; plugins and widgets must not be resold or redistributed; paid resources use the Community Paid Resource License
risks: Free files default to CC BY 4.0, expressly not a public domain license
Attribution requirements for plugins and widgets are not stated on the help page — check the official page
Trademark use is not addressed on the help page — check the official page
The scope of the Figma free (Starter) plan is not verified — check the official page
offers.sourceName: Figma official Community copyright and licensing help page
offers.notes: Paid files: a buyer can share file contents with up to five editors and incorporate file contents into an unlimited number of outputs (designs, apps, websites, and similar), but outputs must differ significantly from the file contents, must involve time, effort, and skill, and their primary value must not come from the file contents themselves; files must not be resold or redistributed (beyond the allowed scope). Paid-file creators cannot offer commercial files under other terms; plugin and widget creators can supplement the Community Paid Resource License. Free preview content inside paid Figma Design files uses CC BY 4.0.

license.licenseId: per-resource: CC BY 4.0 (free files) / Community Free Resource License (plugins & widgets) / Community Paid Resource License (paid)
license.paywallBoundary: Paid resources use the Community Paid Resource License; the scope of the Figma free (Starter) plan is not verified — check the official page.
